name: Support
description: Builds Resolve through healing, barriers, and ally protection effects.

focuses.name: Greater Benediction
focuses.description: Benediction affects your next 2 Essence abilities. The second ability receives 70% of the Benediction bonus.

focuses.name: Sanctuary
focuses.description: Benediction creates an 8 second Sanctuary. You and allies affected by Benediction take 10% less damage. Solo fallback: you gain 10% damage reduction.

focuses.name: Miracle Timing
focuses.description: Benedicted effects on targets below 35% Health gain +20% Effect Potency. If the Benedicted ability is hostile and the enemy is targeting a low-Health ally, that enemy deals 10% less damage for 5 seconds.

coreMechanic: Gain Resolve from healing and barrier effects. At 100 Resolve, empower the next heal or barrier.
